title: Griefing attack on claimable rewards
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In the calculation of the rewards, done in the `ResolvStakingCheckpoints.checkpoint()` function, the value of the new claimable amount is truncated.
